name: comp-19
blurb: Email input with a send button on the right.
description: An email input field with an inline send button (SendIcon) on the right side. Button has focus states and disabled styling but no handler logic.
use_when: A simple email subscription or message form that fits on one line with visual confirmation of the action.
avoid_when: The button needs custom styling or the form is multi-step; the button is fixed-size and tightly coupled.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label. Icon marked aria-hidden. Includes focus-visible ring and disabled states.
